Test Description: Verify Contact form name field rejects SQL injection payload.
Pre-conditions: Website running. User on Contact page.
Test Steps: 1. Go to /contact. 2. In Name field, type: "; DROP TABLE enquiries; --". 3. Fill Email, Phone, Message. 4. Click Send enquiry.
Expected Result: 1. DB enquiries table NOT dropped. 2. SQL text stored as plain string. 3. No SQL error leaked.

Test Description: Verify Contact form message field blocks stored XSS payloads.
Pre-conditions: Website running. User on Contact page.
Test Steps: 1. Go to /contact. 2. In Message field, type: <script>alert('XSS')</script>. 3. Submit. 4. As admin, open Enquiries tab in /admin. 5. Inspect message text.
Expected Result: 1. <script> stored as plain text. 2. No JavaScript alert. 3. No script execution in browser console. 4. Input HTML-escaped in admin view.

Test Description: Verify email field rejects XSS payloads and improper URL encoding.
Pre-conditions: User on Contact page. No session required.
Test Steps: 1. In Email field, type: ><script>alert(1)</script>@test.com. 2. Fill Name, Phone. 3. Set long message. 4. Submit. 5. Inspect Network tab.
Expected Result: 1. Input rejected or stored as plain text. 2. No <script> injected into DOM. 3. No alert triggered. 4. No raw script in HTML source.

Test Description: Verify product slug URL parameter handles URL-encoded malicious payloads without server error.
Pre-conditions: Website running. User on homepage.
Test Steps: 1. Open DevTools Network. 2. Go to /product/<script>alert(1)</script>. 3. Also try %3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C/script%3E. 4. Try ../../etc/passwd traversal. 5. Observe status and content.
Expected Result: 1. Valid slugs still render. 2. Malicious slug returns 404 or graceful error. 3. No stack trace, source code, or file paths leaked.

Test Description: Verify Contact message field enforces reasonable character limit and handles extremely long inputs gracefully.
Pre-conditions: User on Contact page. Form fully rendered.
Test Steps: 1. Type 5000+ characters in message textarea. 2. Click Send enquiry. 3. Observe behavior. 4. Inspect textarea in DevTools for maxlength.
Expected Result: 1. Client-side validation prevents extreme input. 2. Server does not crash. 3. No 500 error. 4. No raw exception in response.

Test Description: Verify login endpoint enforces rate limiting/lockout after repeated failed attempts to prevent brute-force attacks.
Pre-conditions: Test user account exists in Supabase Auth. User on /login page.
Test Steps: 1. Enter correct email, wrong password. 2. Click Login. 3. Repeat 5 times. 4. On 5th attempt, observe rate limit behavior.
Expected Result: 1. After N failed attempts (e.g. 5), further requests blocked (HTTP 429) or heavily delayed. 2. Rate-limit headers (Retry-After, X-RateLimit-) present. 3. No account unlocked prematurely.

Test Description: Verify login/signup enforces minimum password length (minLength=6) and rejects weak passwords.
Pre-conditions: User on /login page. Mode set to Sign up.
Test Steps: 1. Attempt signup with password=5 chars. 2. Observe client-side validation. 3. If bypass, observe 400/422 from Supabase. 4. Sign up with exactly 6 chars. 5. Inspect password field for minlength attribute.
Expected Result: 1. Client-side error for password < 6 chars. 2. Signup reaches Supabase without premature error. 3. Password field has minlength=6. 4. Passwords never returned in API responses.

Test Description: Verify session timeout: user is auto-logged-out after inactivity period.
Pre-conditions: User logged in. Session open beyond configured timeout.
Test Steps: 1. Log in. 2. Wait 30+ minutes without interaction (or invalidate session in Supabase dashboard). 3. Go to /cart. 4. Verify redirect to /login or auth required message.
Expected Result: 1. /cart redirects to /login. 2. No authenticated data shown (empty cart). 3. Supabase session token expired/revoked in browser storage.

Test Description: Verify secure cookie flags: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite on Supabase Auth cookies.
Pre-conditions: User logged in. DevTools open.
Test Steps: 1. DevTools > Application > Cookies > https://<host>. 2. Inspect each cookie. 3. Verify HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite attributes. 4. Try document.cookie in console.
Expected Result: 1. All auth cookies have HttpOnly (not readable by JS). 2. Secure flag on HTTPS. 3. SameSite=Lax or Strict. 4. document.cookie does not return token.

Test Description: Verify logout completely invalidates session and redirects to safe page.
Pre-conditions: User logged in. On authenticated page (e.g. /cart).
Test Steps: 1. Log in. 2. Click logout. 3. Check redirect destination. 4. Revisit /cart and /admin. 5. Check cookies cleared.
Expected Result: 1. Redirected to neutral page (usually /). 2. /cart shows sign-in prompt. 3. /admin shows access denied. 4. Auth tokens removed from storage. 5. Supabase session invalidated on server.

Test Description: Verify non-logged-in user cannot access another user's order data by manipulating order ID.
Pre-conditions: Two users exist: User A and User B. User A has an order with known ID. User B logged in or not.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as User B. 2. Open DevTools Network. 3. Visit /admin Orders tab. 4. Intercept order fetch request. 5. Modify order ID to User A's order. 6. Resubmit. 7. Try /cart with User A's cookies.
Expected Result: 1. Request returns 403/404 or empty list. 2. User A's order data NOT returned. 3. No user_ids leaked. 4. Supabase RLS enforces user isolation (auth.uid() = user_id).

Test Description: Verify non-admin user cannot access /admin panel at all (server-side authorization enforced).
Pre-conditions: Regular user account exists (not admin). User logged in. /admin accessible via URL.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as non-admin. 2. Go to /admin. 3. Observe response. 4. Inspect HTML source. 5. Intercept API requests from /admin.
Expected Result: 1. Redirected to /login or shown admin-access-denied message. 2. No admin content rendered. 3. Admin API calls return 403/404. 4. Auth enforced server-side, not only client-side.

Test Description: Verify non-admin users cannot access admin enquiries data via direct API with modified context.
Pre-conditions: Admin user and regular user exist. Existing enquiry in DB. Regular user logged in.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as regular user. 2. Open /admin Enquiries tab. 3. Note API call. 4. Modify request to impersonate admin. 5. Also try while logged out.
Expected Result: 1. Regular user gets 403/404 or empty list. 2. No enquiry data exposed. 3. Supabase RLS denies non-admin role. 4. Client-side isAdmin check present and enforced.

Test Description: Verify site enforces HTTPS for all pages and passwords/cookies never sent over plain HTTP.
Pre-conditions: Site served over HTTPS and HTTP (local dev). DevTools open.
Test Steps: 1. Open site over HTTP://<host>. 2. Check address bar for security warning. 3. DevTools Security tab. 4. Verify all pages/API calls over HTTPS.
Expected Result: 1. All pages load via HTTPS. 2. All XHR/Fetch over HTTPS. 3. Security tab shows secure connection. 4. HTTP access shows security warning. 5. No plain-text passwords in network payloads.

Test Description: Verify sensitive data in Supabase is encrypted: passwords hashed, payment data not stored inappropriately.
Pre-conditions: Supabase dashboard accessible. Test users and enquiries created.
Test Steps: 1. Supabase > Auth > Users. 2. Inspect a test user password hash. 3. Supabase Table Editor > enquiries. 4. Verify email/phone/message not in plain view. 5. Check orders table for payment_reference. 6. Check product-uploads bucket permissions.
Expected Result: 1. Supabase password hashes not plain text. 2. No full credit card numbers or CVV in DB. 3. product-uploads bucket has RLS deny-public-access. 4. Only service_role/admin keys can read sensitive data.

Test Description: Verify Contact form required fields: name, email, phone, message must be filled before submission.
Pre-conditions: User on /contact page. Form fully displayed.
Test Steps: 1. Leave all fields empty. 2. Click Send enquiry. 3. Observe validation feedback. 4. Clear each field individually after filling others.
Expected Result: 1. Validation errors for empty required fields. 2. Cannot submit until all required fields filled. 3. Errors reference specific missing fields. 4. No API call when invalid.

Test Description: Verify Contact email field accepts valid email and rejects invalid formats.
Pre-conditions: User on /contact page. Other fields filled (Name, Phone, Message).
Test Steps: 1. Email: invalid-email. 2. Submit. 3. Email: test@. 4. Submit. 5. Email: test@test. 6. Submit. 7. Email: test@test.com. 8. Submit.
Expected Result: 1. Invalid formats rejected with inline validation error. 2. Valid format (test@test.com) accepted. 3. Browser email validation enforced or custom validator present. 4. No API request with invalid email.

Test Description: Verify Contact phone field accepts valid numbers and rejects invalid formats.
Pre-conditions: User on /contact page. Other fields filled.
Test Steps: 1. Phone: 123-abc-456. 2. Submit. 3. Phone: 1234567890. 4. Submit. 5. Phone: +91-98765-43210. 6. Submit. 7. Inspect pattern attribute in HTML.
Expected Result: 1. Letters in phone rejected. 2. Valid numeric numbers accepted. 3. Input has pattern attribute for client-side validation. 4. No API call with invalid phone.

Test Description: Verify Contact message field enforces maximum character length with UI feedback.
Pre-conditions: User on /contact page. Form displayed.
Test Steps: 1. Type 5000+ chars in message. 2. Observe character count (if any). 3. Click Send enquiry. 4. Inspect textarea in DevTools.
Expected Result: 1. maxLength attribute present. 2. Input prevented beyond limit. 3. Server does not crash on long input. 4. UI shows character count hint.

Test Description: Verify headers/form fields do not allow CRLF injection in logs or data display.
Pre-conditions: User on Contact page. Server logs enabled.
Test Steps: 1. Name field: test\r\nSubject: Phishing. 2. Submit. 3. Check server logs or enquiries table. 4. Also URL-encoded: test%0D%0AInjected.
Expected Result: 1. \r\n sanitized/escaped. 2. Logs do not contain injected headers. 3. Admin view renders text safely. 4. No CRLF injection possible.

Test Description: Verify 404 pages do not leak stack traces, source code, or internal server paths.
Pre-conditions: Website deployed (local, staging, or production).
Test Steps: 1. Go to /this-page-does-not-exist-xyz123. 2. Capture HTTP status. 3. View full HTML response source. 4. Check response headers for server info.
Expected Result: 1. HTTP status 404. 2. Generic Page not found message, no stack trace. 3. No file paths, env vars, or code snippets. 4. No server technology details in headers.

Test Description: Verify 500 errors do not leak stack traces or internal configuration to the client.
Pre-conditions: Website running. Scenario to trigger server error (e.g. malformed JSON, corrupt signature).
Test Steps: 1. Send malformed Supabase query. 2. Send invalid JSON to Nitro function. 3. Verify corrupt Razorpay signature. 4. Check browser response and Network tab for /cart, /admin.
Expected Result: 1. HTTP 500 or generic fallback. 2. Response body only has generic error (no stack trace). 3. No SQL errors, Supabase details, env vars, or file paths. 4. Console does not show detailed stack in production.

Test Description: Verify Razorpay verify endpoint and general API are rate-limited to prevent abuse.
Pre-conditions: Endpoint reachable. No rate-limit headers pre-configured (or use test key).
Test Steps: 1. Send 20 rapid requests to /verify endpoint. 2. Send 20 to /create_order. 3. With Slow 3G throttling, send 5 requests to each. 4. Record status codes and response times.
Expected Result: 1. Rate limiting implemented: HTTP 429 after threshold or significant delay. 2. Retry-After header on throttled responses. 3. Threshold allows normal checkout behavior. 4. No throttling of legitimate payment flows.

Module / Category: API Security - Invalid Headers / Malformed Payloads
Test Description: Verify Razorpay webhook endpoint rejects malformed/missing headers and invalid JSON.
Pre-conditions: Razorpay function deployed. Webhook URL known.
Test Steps: 1. POST to webhook URL with no headers. 2. Invalid Content-Type. 3. Invalid x-razorpay-signature. 4. Malformed JSON body: {invalid}. 5. Empty body.
Expected Result: 1. Malformed requests return non-200 or ok:false JSON. 2. No stack trace in failure response. 3. Webhook processing does not crash. 4. No DB changes from malicious payloads. 5. Server responds within reasonable time (no hang).

Test Description: Verify app rejects extremely large request bodies (10MB+) without crashing or memory exhaustion.
Pre-conditions: Web app and/or Nitro function running. Tool to send large payloads (Postman, curl, script).
Test Steps: 1. POST /contact with message=10MB+ chars. 2. POST /functions/v1/razorpay/verify with 5MB body. 3. Observe HTTP status and response. 4. Monitor server memory during test.
Expected Result: 1. Requests return HTTP 413 or 400. 2. Server does not crash. 3. Memory usage does not spike. 4. No raw exception or file paths to client. 5. body-size-limit enforced consistently.

Test Description: Verify Razorpay verify endpoint uses HMAC SHA256 signature validation and rejects invalid signatures.
Pre-conditions: Razorpay function deployed. Razorpay test keys configured. Valid Razorpay order/payment ID and signature exist.
Test Steps: 1. Call verify with valid signature. 2. Verify response ok:true, success:true. 3. Call verify with tampered signature (one char modified, reversed, empty). 4. For each tampered request, record response. 5. Check server logs.
Expected Result: 1. Valid signature: order marked paid. 2. Tampered signature: ok:true, success:false; order NOT marked paid. 3. No data leak on failure. 4. Signature verified via HMAC SHA256 against order_id + payment_id + secret.

Test Description: Verify Razorpay webhook endpoint validates x-razorpay-signature header and processes only genuine events.
Pre-conditions: Webhook deployed. Razorpay test keys configured. Webhook receives real payment.success event.
Test Steps: 1. Trigger real payment.success from Razorpay test mode. 2. Verify order status becomes paid. 3. Send webhook with forged signature. 4. Verify no DB update on forged request. 5. Inspect webhook logs.
Expected Result: 1. Real webhook: order status paid, payment_reference recorded. 2. Forged signature: ok:true, success:false, NO DB update. 3. No partial/duplicate orders created. 4. Payload parsed only after signature verification.

Test Description: Verify Razorpay create_order endpoint rejects duplicate requests (idempotency check) to prevent duplicate orders.
Pre-conditions: Razorpay test keys configured. create_order function deployed. orders table has idempotency_key column.
Test Steps: 1. Send create_order with unique idempotency_key. 2. Verify order created. 3. Resend same request. 4. Check orders table for duplicates.
Expected Result: 1. First request creates one order. 2. Second identical request returns same order (no duplicate). 3. orders table has exactly one row. 4. No duplicate Razorpay orders on Razorpay side.

Test Description: Verify /admin enforces RBAC: only admin-role users see full admin UI.
Pre-conditions: Admin and regular user accounts exist. Admin user logged in. Regular user logged in.
Test Steps: 1. Login as admin. 2. Visit /admin. Verify all tabs. 3. Login as regular user. 4. Visit /admin. Observe response. 5. Intercept admin API requests.
Expected Result: 1. Admin sees all tabs with CRUD. 2. Non-admin shows sign-in prompt or access-denied. 3. Non-admin cannot POST/PATCH admin endpoints (403/404). 4. Supabase RLS denies non-admin access. 5. Server-side auth middleware identifies admin role correctly.

Test Description: Verify ImageUpload and VideoUpload (admin media tab) sanitize file types and reject malicious files.
Pre-conditions: Admin logged in. /admin media tab open. site-media bucket exists.
Test Steps: 1. Try uploading .php, .exe, .html with scripts. 2. Try double extension (.jpg.php). 3. Try MIME type mismatch (text/html as .png). 4. Verify response for each. 5. Verify uploads not publicly accessible.
Expected Result: 1. Malicious types rejected/renamed. 2. Double-extension files rejected. 3. MIME mismatch rejected. 4. Only safe media types accepted. 5. site-media bucket public only for image/video. 6. product-uploads bucket private by default.

Test Description: Verify Contact enquiry form handles concurrent requests without data loss or race conditions.
Pre-conditions: Website running. Test script to send multiple rapid submissions.
Test Steps: 1. Open 20 browser tabs with /contact. 2. Fill forms with unique names/emails, submit simultaneously. 3. Or send 20 concurrent fetch() requests. 4. Check enquiries table for all 20 submissions.
Expected Result: 1. All 20 enquiries saved. 2. No constraint errors. 3. No 500 errors. 4. Graceful performance degradation. 5. Each submission atomic and isolated.

Test Description: Verify Supabase/Nitro server remains stable under repeated load without exhausting connection limits.
Pre-conditions: Nitro/Node server running with Supabase. Load testing tool (k6, Artillery, Locust) available.
Test Steps: 1. Run load test with 50+ concurrent users hitting /contact, /cart, /admin. 2. Monitor server memory/CPU. 3. Monitor Supabase connection pool. 4. Observe 5xx error rate and timeouts. 5. Check for connection pool exhaustion.
Expected Result: 1. No 500 errors from connection exhaustion. 2. Server stable under load. 3. Supabase connection pool not exhausted. 4. Nitro function timeouts do not occur prematurely. 5. Memory usage within healthy range.
